$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFJI (AIP France, chart dated 2025-09-04): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Marennes

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for home based ACFT and ACFT based on the neighbouring AD (1).
AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT Simultaneous use of RWY and adjacent TWY prohibited.
AD likely to be covered by sea haze in a few minutes.
Pilots attention is especially drawn to trees which penetrate clearing aeronautical area in the south west landing funnel: Grove located 360 m before DTHR 04 at 110 ft AMSL.
Preferential landing QFU 041° due to obstacles in take off funnel QFU 221°.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Low height circuits below 500 ft AAL: only with instructor on board.
Absence of RWY holding point marking sign: All ACFT must hold short off RWY at least 30 m from RWY edge (1) AD voisins/ Neighbouring AD:
AD réservé aux ACFT basés et à ceux basés sur les AD voisins (1).
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio Utilisation simultanée de la piste et du TWY accolé interdite.
Site susceptible d'être envahi en quelques minutes par la brume de mer.

L'attention de l'utilisateur est spécialement attirée sur la présence d'arbres qui percent les surfaces de dégagement aéronautiques dans la trouée d'atterrissage au sud-ouest : Bosquet 360 m en amont du seuil décalé 04 altitude 110 ft AMSL.
QFU préférentiel 041° cause obstacles dans la trouée de décollage QFU 221°.
Roulage interdit hors RWY et TWY.
Circuits basse hauteur inférieurs à 500 ft AAL : avec instructeur uniquement.

Absence de panneau et de marque d'indication d'arrêt avant piste : tout aéronef doit attendre à une distance du bord de la piste au moins égale à 30 m.
